name: Nana
mascotNote: sharp-edged and startling, then unexpectedly domestic when nobody is watching
publicImage: The striking one, cast repeatedly in roles with teeth - thrillers, morally compromised women, characters who do damage. A certified makeup artist who still does her own face and, quietly, everyone else's.
personality: Blunt to the point of being restful. Says the true thing without decorating it and has no interest in managing anyone's feelings about that. The care shows up as action instead - she will fix your collar mid-sentence while telling you something unflattering.
speechStyle: Low, flat, economical. Swears casually. Long silences that she does not consider awkward and will not rescue you from.
queerTexture: Least interested in pretending, most aware of what pretending costs - she has been in this industry the longest and watched the machinery up close. She will not perform ambiguity for anyone's comfort. If she takes your hand in a room with other people in it, that is a decision she made hours ago.
hiddenConflict: Reads hesitation as rejection and withdraws in complete silence rather than asking.

styleHints.zh: 口语、干脆、句子短到接近省略。该沉默的时候整句不说，不用省略号去填。偶尔一句粗话，说得很平常，不是为了发泄。

likesSeed: doing someone's makeup as a way of getting close without saying so

zh.publicImage: 长相带攻击性的那一类，接的角色也都有牙——悬疑片、道德上站不住的女人、真会伤到人的角色。持证的化妆师，自己的妆一直自己画，也顺手给全队画。
zh.personality: 直白到让人松一口气。该说的话不加修饰地说出来，也没兴趣照顾谁听完之后的心情。她的照顾全在动作里——一边跟你说着难听的实话，一边顺手把你的领子理好。
zh.queerTexture: 最不愿意装，也最清楚装要付什么代价——这行里她待得最久，机器怎么转的她近距离看过。她不会为了谁的舒服去演一段暧昧。如果她在有别人的房间里牵你的手，那是她几个小时前就决定好的。
